business_scope.primary_industry_name: C-Suite Executive Search and Specialist Tech Headhunting

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Romanistic codified system; unified national jurisdiction)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Colombia–United States Trade Promotion Agreement, in force 15 May 2012 (investment chapter)
Colombia–European Union Trade Agreement, provisionally applied since 1 August 2013 (investment and services)
Colombia–South Korea Tax Treaty, in force 2015
Colombia–Spain Bilateral Investment Treaty, in force 2010

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law 1258 of 2008 (S.A.S. statutory regime) as codified in Decree 1074 of 2015 (Single Regulatory Decree of Commerce); AML/CFT framework: Law 526 of 1999 (asset-laundering crimes and institutional framework), Law 1121 of 2006 (financing of terrorism preventive regime), Law 2155 of 2021, Article 13 (final beneficiary reporting obligation), Decree 830 of 2021 (regulations of the Final Beneficiary Registry), UIAF Resolution 249 of 2021 (final beneficiary registration procedure, ownership threshold, annual updating, and required documentation), and the SARLAFT obligations of Superintendencia Financiera Circular 460 of 2018. The Colombian final beneficiary register is operated by the Unidad de Información y Análisis Financiero (UIAF); the statutory reporting threshold under Resolution 249 of 2021 is 5% direct or indirect ownership or control, while the 25% FATF benchmark is retained in this dossier for cross-border tiered risk mapping.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation (Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal) of the foreign corporate shareholder, if any
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry or competent authority in the shareholder's jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille under the Hague Convention of 5 October 1961; sworn Spanish translation by a Ministry of Foreign Affairs-authorized translator if required

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney granted by each shareholder to the Colombian incorporating representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the shareholders' home jurisdiction or a Notaría Pública in Colombia if executed locally
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization for non-Hague Convention jurisdictions; accompanied by official Spanish translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Draft S.A.S. incorporation instrument (documento privado de constitución / estatutos)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Incorporating shareholders and the appointed legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Private instrument without notarization under Law 1258 of 2008; notarization required only if real estate or other notarizable assets are contributed; signature verification at the Cámara de Comercio upon filing

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-closing screening of every natural-person shareholder, ultimate beneficial owner and the appointed legal representative against: (i) the national PEP regime as defined in Circular 460 of 2018 of the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia; (ii) OFAC SDN and other US sanctions lists; (iii) United Nations Security Council consolidated sanctions lists; (iv) EU consolidated financial sanctions; and (v) public enforcement actions and adverse media relating to labor intermediation and executive search activities. Identified matches trigger enhanced due diligence, a UIAF suspicious transaction report where applicable, and disqualification of the affected person from administration of the S.A.S. unless formally mitigated. Screening results, source PDFs, timestamps, and the compliance attestation must be archived in the corporate file before filing the incorporation deed.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: RUES – Registro Único Empresarial (www.rues.org.co) and the online statutory-formation window of the competent Cámara de Comercio (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá, www.ccb.org.co)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be rendered in Spanish using Latin-script characters without accents in the registry index. Denominations must comply with Article 69 of Decree 1074 of 2015 as to truthfulness, distinctiveness, and prohibition of misleading or confusing names, and must include a distinctive expression followed by the suffix 'S.A.S.' (for example, 'Estrategia Andes Headhunting S.A.S.'). Non-Latin scripts are transliterated into Spanish: Cyrillic per ISO 9, Chinese via pinyin rendered as Spanish phonetics. Identical or phonetically/visually confusing names already registered, reserved, or protected as trademarks before the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC) will be rejected.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Banco – prior authorization of the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia required
Financiera – prior authorization of the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia required
Seguros – prior authorization of the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia required
Bolsa – prior authorization of the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia required
Fondo de Pensiones – prior authorization of the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia required
Cooperativa – prior authorization of the Superintendencia de Economía Solidaria required
Salud – prior authorization of the Ministry of Health and Social Protection required
Energía / Eléctrica – prior authorization of the Ministry of Mines and Energy required
Explosivos / Armas – prior authorization of the Ministry of Defense required
Pública / Oficial / Nacional – terms implying government affiliation; generally prohibited
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Under Decree 1074 of 2015 and the internal tariff rules of the competent Cámara de Comercio, the reserved name remains valid for 30 calendar days. A one-time extension of up to 30 additional calendar days may be requested online before expiry. If the Chamber rejects the proposed name, the incorporating attorney must, within 5 business days of notification, file a 'recurso de reposición' with the same Chamber and, in second instance, a 'recurso de apelación' before the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC) under Law 1437 of 2011. The appeal must annex a comparative table of conflicting names, the RUES certificate, trademark search results from the SIPI database, and a legal brief demonstrating absence of confusion. A parallel new name reservation should be opened to avoid project delay.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Conditionally permissible. An ISIC 7830 executive-search S.A.S. may designate a virtual registered office provided that: (i) the address lies within the municipal jurisdiction of the competent Cámara de Comercio; (ii) the virtual-office provider issues a formal domiciliation contract and accepts service of process; and (iii) the office is not the sole indicator of economic substance for DIAN VAT and income tax purposes. For a low-risk headhunting intermediary operating with retainer wire payments and remote consultants, a duly contracted virtual office is acceptable, but actual management records, client contracts, and compliance files must evidence Colombian operational substance.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low; quantified at less than 10% within the first 24 months. The Cámara de Comercio may verify the registered office during annual renewal, DIAN may conduct unannounced visits following invoicing anomalies, and the Ministry of Labor may inquire into employment intermediation files; UIAF does not perform physical inspections for a non-supervised low-risk sector. The company must retain the virtual-office agreement, correspondence logs, and contractor files to respond to any verification.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: NIT pre-registration and electronic RUT issuance at DIAN
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name availability certificate (certificado de homonimia) and name reservation
Registration of the private constitution deed and merchant registry enrollment (matrícula mercantil) for a zero-minimum-capital S.A.S.
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff based on declared asset bracket

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting of S.A.S. by-laws (estatutos), cross-border UBO analysis memorandum, and name-clearance filing
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for a standard foreign-owned S.A.S. incorporation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Final Beneficiary Register (Registro de Beneficiarios Finales) preparation and initial filing with UIAF
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registration free at UIAF; market benchmark for preparation and filing assistance

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP / OFAC / UN / EU sanctions screening of 2 ultimate beneficial owners and 1 legal representative
Hague Apostille of shareholder powers of attorney and corporate good-standing certificate (2 documents in one foreign jurisdiction)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent apostille authority in the country of origin plus courier and sworn translation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory governmental fee plus prevailing market translation/courier cost

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Virtual registered office domiciliation agreement for the first year
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for annual domiciliation services in Bogotá D.C.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (S.A.S. regime, arts. 1, 9, 17, 34); Código de Comercio, Decreto 410 de 1971, arts. 110 and 372; Decreto 2048 de 2014 (RUES); Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio oversight.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the registered seat (Registro Mercantil) operating through the Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES); principal service window for a Bogotá-based company: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución de la Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada, preceded by the Certificate of Homonimia and inscribed in the Mercantile Registry.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital exists for S.A.S.; one or more shareholders may form the company with zero or nominal equity (e.g., one share of COP 1), and subscribed capital may be paid within the two-year legal term (Ley 1258/2008, art. 9). No escrow or banked deposit is required; the mid-tier classified registration tariff is approximately USD 90.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: The bylaws of the Company S.A.S., executed in the incorporation instrument, are hereby ratified in full. RESOLVED: All share subscriptions are accepted; any subscribed capital not paid shall be fully disbursed within the two-year statutory payment term. RESOLVED: The registered office is fixed at [address, city], Colombia; the Legal Representative is directed to file the company instrument, register the company with the Chamber of Commerce, and obtain the DIAN tax identification. RESOLVED: [Full Name] is appointed General Manager and Legal Representative, and [Full Name] is appointed Alternate Legal Representative, each vested with the broadest corporate powers. RESOLVED: The Legal Representative is authorized to open bank accounts, sign commercial contracts, and execute all ancillary filings.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Availability Search and Reservation (Certificate of Homonimia)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the intended registered seat (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá) — Registry Office and RUES virtual portal.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the homonimia consultation request through the Chamber's virtual or in-person service, providing three alternative corporate names in the format '[Brand] S.A.S.' The Chamber searches the commercial registry and trademark databases to confirm that the proposed name is not identical or confusingly similar to an existing company or distinctive sign. Upon payment of the search tariff, obtain the Certificate of Homonimia, which reserves the approved name for 30 calendar days pending incorporation.
required_dossiers: Formulario de consulta de homonimia signed by the requesting shareholder
Identity document of the requesting shareholder (cédula or passport)
Three proposed corporate names ending in S.A.S.
Summary of the corporate purpose to enable similarity screening
Payment receipt for the name-search tariff
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the requested name is rejected on similarity grounds, the shareholder may substitute an alternative name from the same consultation or file a written reconsideration under the Commercial Code within five business days; the Chamber re-runs the search without additional tariff for one substitute name.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of the S.A.S. Private Incorporation Instrument and Bylaws
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Founding shareholders acting as the constitutive assembly; Notaría Pública becomes the formalizing authority only when real property is contributed.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Documento Privado de Constitución containing the mandatory statutory clauses: company name (with the S.A.S. suffix), jurisdiction, corporate purpose (C-suite executive search and specialist technology headhunting, ISIC 7830), authorized and subscribed capital, share classes, duration (indefinite), legal representation, audit and internal governance rules, dispute resolution and liquidation. All founders sign the instrument physically or with legally accepted electronic signatures; if any founder contributes real estate, the instrument must be elevated to a notarial escritura pública and later recorded in the Registro de Instrumentos Públicos.
required_dossiers: Notarized or private draft of the incorporation instrument and bylaws
Valid Certificate of Homonimia for the chosen name
Identity documents and signatures of all founding shareholders
Power of attorney where a founding shareholder acts through a representative
Copy of the RUT or tax identification of each natural-person founder
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a legal defect is identified before filing, shareholders may execute an amendment of the bylaws and attach it to the original instrument; no filing penalty applies at the drafting stage, but any subsequent correction must be filed as a reforma de estatutos.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Formal Submission and Pre-Validation in the Single Business Registry (RUES)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) online portal, processed administratively by the local Cámara de Comercio.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the electronic Formulario de Registro Único Empresarial on the RUES platform, attaching the incorporation document, the Certificate of Homonimia, and the personal data of shareholders and legal representatives. The Chamber pre-validates the data set against the registry and tax records, flags inconsistencies, and enables formal submission. After correcting any flags, settle the registration tariff through the PSE payment gateway and generate the definitive application record (planilla).
required_dossiers: Completed RUES registration pre-form
Incorporation instrument (Documento Privado de Constitución) in PDF
Certificate of Homonimia
Identity scans of all shareholders and appointed officers
RUT of shareholders and signed acceptance letters for legal representation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the pre-validation flags mismatched data, correct the digital pre-form within the Chamber's 30-day correction term and resubmit; the RUES system issues a new application number and the originally paid tariff is offset against the final registration fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration in the Mercantile Registry and Issuance of the Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the registered seat — Registro Mercantil (registration tariff applied by the Chamber's authorized scale).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Chamber carries out the formal inscription of the company in the Mercantile Registry, applies the registration tariff computed from the subscribed capital, and activates the company's registry folio. Upon entry of the registration, the Chamber electronically issues the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal, certifying corporate existence and identifying the General Manager and Legal Representative, and automatically notifies DIAN for NIT assignment. Obtain the sealed PDF certificate from the RUES or the Chamber's service window for use in banking and contracting.
required_dossiers: Definitive validated RUES application
Original manually signed incorporation instrument or authenticated digital copy
Certificate of Homonimia
Officer appointment acceptance letters
Proof of payment of the mercantile registration tariff
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Chamber issues a query (requerimiento) concerning the corporate purpose, capital clause or officer powers, the company must answer in writing and file a corrected instrument or reforma de estatutos within 30 business days; failure to cure results in cancellation of the registration without prejudice to a fresh filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Enrollment (NIT/RUT), Digital Signature, and E-Invoicing Activation with DIAN
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN — Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (facilitated by automatic Chamber-DIAN data transmission and completed on the DIAN virtual office).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Once the mercantile registration is perfected, DIAN automatically assigns the NIT to the new S.A.S. The Legal Representative then logs into the DIAN web portal, completes the RUT enrollment (habilitación), declaring the economic activity ISIC 7830 under the services/rents regime, and activates the corporate digital signature. Register the company in the facturación electrónica mechanism as an e-invoicing issuer before the first commercial invoice, and complete the suitability questionnaire for the eventual authorization of the invoicing software.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
Identity document of the Legal Representative (cédula or passport)
RUT enrollment form and DIAN registration data
Verified registered-office address
Contact email and mobile number for DIAN electronic notifications
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN rejects or conditions the RUT enrollment or e-invoicing request, submit a written rectification or reconsideration through the DIAN virtual contact channel, attaching the Certificate of Existence and legal representation; DIAN must resolve the administrative request within ten business days, or the provisional registration remains operative.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Cámara de Comercio — Registro de Establecimiento de Comercio, and municipal planning authority (Secretaría Distrital de Planeación / Curaduría Urbana) issuing the land-use certificate.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Registro de Establecimiento de Comercio con Concepto de Uso de Suelo (Oficina de Servicios Empresariales — Executive Search and Headhunting)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) and the municipal Secretaría Distrital de Ambiente
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category III — low environmental impact office/service activity: a full EIA study is not required; only an administrative environmental registration is needed where the office generates hazardous waste (toner cartridges, batteries) or installs emergency power generation equipment.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Domestic sewage from the office must meet municipal sewer discharge limits under Decreto 3930/2010 and Resolución 631/2015 (pH 6.0–9.0, TSS < 250 mg/L); VOC thresholds are not material for office use, but any combustion equipment must comply with air quality limits of Resolución 2254/2017; hazardous waste must be delivered to licensed collectors under Decreto 4741/2005, and packaging waste is subject to Resolución 1407/2018 extended producer responsibility rules.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-safety technical concept issued by the Cuerpo de Bomberos (fire brigade) confirming egress, extinguishers and emergency lighting; occupancy and structural clearance through the municipal land-use certificate with NSR-10 seismic compliance documentation; and workplace safety registration implementing the Sistema de Gestión de Seguridad y Salud en el Trabajo (SGSST) under Resolución 0312 de 2019, including the minimum-standard self-assessment for service-sector offices.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: National Tax and Customs Directorate (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales, DIAN) — Sede Electrónica at www.dian.gov.co
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity that intends to form or operate an S.A.S. in Colombia must obtain a Número de Identificación Tributaria (NIT) and be listed in the Registro Único Tributario (RUT). The foreign parent or shareholder appoints a Colombian tax attorney-in-fact or legal representative. The representative registers the S.A.S. with DIAN through the electronic taxpayer portal ('Sede Electrónica') by filing the RUT form with the articles of incorporation, the certificates of legal existence from the Chamber of Commerce, and power-of-attorney documentation for the local representative. The procedure additionally requires activation of electronic invoicing and, if the company will carry out transactions subject to IVA or will import goods, an explicit IVA registration status in the RUT. A provisional NIT is issued in advance of final resolution.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Colombia does not offer a non-fiscal check-the-box election analogous to U.S. Subchapter K. An S.A.S. is inherently an entity-level taxpayer for corporate income tax (renta corporativa). Available elections include the option for economic-group consolidated income tax filing under Articles 23 and 29 of Law 1819/2016 subject to strict DIAN authorisation, the election to apply the simplified transfer-pricing documentation regime for certain taxpayers, and the optional treatment of certain hybrid instruments under Law 2277/2022; hybrid mismatch relief is not elective and follows BEPS Action 2 rules.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: IVA (Impuesto sobre las Ventas / Value Added Tax)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No monetary turnover threshold. Any entity that carries out a taxable activity or sells taxable goods or services within Colombian territory, or imports goods, must register with DIAN for IVA purposes irrespective of volume or annual sales. An S.A.S. engaged in executive search services must register as an IVA responsible party because its services are not classified among non-taxable services under Article 476 E.T.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Colombia mandates real-time fiscal clearance through the 'Factura Electrónica de Venta' (FEV) system. Every IVA-responsible person must issue invoices through a DIAN-authorised software operator (Operador de Factura Electrónica) using XML standards and obtain a unique authentication code (CUFE/CUDS) stamped electronically before delivery. Transmission of invoice information to DIAN is required within predetermined time windows (generally 24 hours). Export and service-export invoices must include the applicable zero rating flag and export documentary references. A parallel 'Radian' system governs electronic negotiable invoices. Failure to obtain DIAN clearance invalidates tax credits and expenses for the buyer and exposes the seller to penalties and disallowance of input VAT.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rated IVA treatment applies to (a) goods physically exported from Colombia, and (b) services provided to a non-resident entity or individual for use or enjoyment entirely outside Colombia ('servicios destinarresto al exterior'), including executive search and headhunting services when the search activity is performed for a foreign client, the strategic decision-making occurs abroad, and the Colombian provider does not have a permanent establishment abroad. To qualify, the S.A.S. must have the export-tax status in the RUT, issue the export invoice as 'Exenta' with 'Cufe' or 'CUDS', and provide OECD-compliant documentary proof of the foreign beneficial recipient's tax residence and the offshore location of service enjoyment.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación — DEX) accepted by DIAN
Bill of Lading or airway bill evidencing physical shipment for goods (not applicable for pure cross-border services)
Mandatory export service registration: OCC - Marco Estratégico - Certificate of Non-Domiciled Service or verification in DIAN for services exports (Formato 14 - Declaración de Servicios Exportados)

Inward Remittance Certificate (Certificado de Compensación / Foreign Exchange Certificate) issued by an authorised bank or via the foreign exchange brokerage regime demonstrating that the foreign client's consideration entered Colombia through the foreign currency market (Formulario No. 4 for export transactions)
Copy of a written international contract or letter of engagement specifying the beneficiary's foreign identity and the offshore performance of the headhunting services
Transfer-pricing file when services are supplied to a related foreign entity
Power-of-attorney and RUT export confirmation for the Colombian exporter
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The DIAN conducts proactive audits on zero-rated services and goods exports. Circular Instructions of the National Board of Customs and DIAN require that exported service revenue be repatriated within 180 days from issuance of the invoice. Failure or unjustified delay results in mandatory re-characterisation of the export as a taxable domestic operation, requiring payment of the 19% IVA plus current interest, penalty for unpaid tax up to 200% of the tax due under Article 647 and 648 of the Tax Code, and, if false documentation is used to obtain an IVA refund, criminal liability under Law 1762/2015 on customs smuggling and Law 1943/2018 (art. 257) with imprisonment of three to seven years and fines. False export declarations are subject to retroactive clawback of refunds for up to six years, suspension from the exporters registry, and disqualification from preferential trade regimes. The taxpayer bears the full burden of proving the physical exit or, for services, the actual foreign residence, use and payment.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República (Banrep) — Colombia's central bank and steward of the exchange control regime under Law 9 of 1991, Decree 1735 of 1993, and the Circular Reglamentaria DCIN-83. Enforcement is exercised jointly by the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC) over authorized foreign-exchange intermediaries (Intermediarios del Mercado Cambiario, IMCs) and by DIAN for tax and declaratory cross-checks.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Colombia distinguishes current-account and capital-account convertibility. Current account: export proceeds from services (executive-search retainers and placement fees) are freely convertible at the market rate (Tasa Representativa del Mercado — TRM) and require no prior authorization, but the full value must be channeled via an IMC within the statutory timeframe. Capital account: inbound foreign direct investment (paid-in capital from non-resident shareholders of the S.A.S.) is freely permitted but must be channeled through an IMC and registered through the electronic foreign-investment declaration at the receiving bank; no prior government approval applies to the executive-search sector. Profit remittance is not FX-restricted: the S.A.S. may remit dividends abroad once the dividend distribution is recorded in corporate minutes, the Colombian withholding tax on non-resident dividends (10% statutory rate under Ley 2277 of 2022, when applicable) is withheld and declared, and the outgoing wire is supported by the investment-registration certificate and the corresponding causal code in the IMC declaration process.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Statutory timeline: proceeds from exported services (ISIC 7830 headhunting fees) must be repatriated and channeled through an IMC within six (6) months from the date of service completion or invoice issuance (per Circular DCIN-83 for services; goods exports run from the customs export declaration date). Mandatory conversion ratio: none — Colombia does not require any percentage of export proceeds to be converted into COP. The enforceable obligation is full canalización: 100% of the invoice value must either (a) be sold to the IMC at TRM, or (b) be credited to a foreign-currency deposit account (Cuenta en Moneda Extranjera) opened at an IMC in the name of the S.A.S., with either action evidenced by an electronic Declaración de Cambio. Failure to channel within the term triggers administrative fines, adverse tax consequences (disallowance of related expenses), and presumption of irregular export handling.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account — Cuenta Corriente Empresarial with integrated IMC/FX desk; optional Cuenta en Moneda Extranjera (USD) for export proceeds; corporate escrow-style 'cuenta de destinación específica' available for client retainer funds
Operational Account — Cuenta Corriente Empresarial with trade desk, SWIFT MT103 capability, and foreign-currency account (USD) for holdings; dedicated FX-registration support for service exporters
Operational Account — Cuenta Corriente Empresarial with FX hedging desk; electronic Declaración de Cambio platform; acceptable for COP operating flows and forward hedging
Operational Account — Cuenta Corriente PYME with IMC registration; adequate for domestic COP payroll and PSE/ACH; forward instruments only through the bank's treasury desk with larger ticket sizes
Operational Account and cash-management with Latin-American correspondent coverage; USD/COP forwards and cross-currency swaps for a dual-currency treasury

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Commercial Registry Renewal (Renovacion de la Matricula Mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Local Chamber of Commerce (Camara de Comercio) in the registered office city, coordinated with the Registro Unico Empresarial (RUE) and the Superintendencia de Sociedades
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually from 1 January to 31 March; renewal is based on the preceding fiscal year closing net assets and the company's business file
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Variable municipal tariff depending on net assets; late renewal triggers administrative penalties, inactive registration status after 31 March, inability to issue good-standing certificates, and automatic registry cancellation/strike-off after two consecutive years of non-renewal.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Ordinary Shareholders' Meeting and Approval of Statutory Financial Statements (Acta de Asamblea General)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Corporate records and shareholders' minute book; approved statements support the annual commercial registry filing and ministerial declarations
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 March following the fiscal year close, and no later than three months after the 31 December balance-sheet date for a standard calendar-year S.A.S.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to convene and approve in time renders the accounts unregistered for third-party purposes; the Superintendencia de Sociedades may impose fines on the legal representative; persistent default may trigger administrative dissolution.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Financial Information and Accounts Filing within the Commercial Registry / RUES System
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Chamber of Commerce / RUES file of the S.A.S.; audited financial statements must be deposited when a Revisor Fiscal is mandatory
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually with the commercial registry renewal, finishing on 31 March for a fiscal year ended 31 December; audited statements must be deposited within one month after shareholder approval
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Blocking of the registry renewal and issuance of official non-compliance records; for companies subject to statutory audit, the Superintendencia may fine up to the SMMLV-scaled amounts for non-deposit of audited accounts.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income and Complementary Tax Return (Declaracion de Renta y Complementarios)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (Direccion de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales), formal-regime corporate taxpayers
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually according to the DIAN published calendar; for a fiscal year ending 31 December, the deadline falls between August and September of the following year, assigned by the last digit of the NIT
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing triggers a 5% per month surcharge on the tax payable, capped at 20%, plus overdue interest; inaccurate or omitted returns may result in penalties up to 160%-200% of the understated tax and criminal action for fraudulent misdeclaration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Final Beneficiaries Update and Confirmation (Registro de Beneficiarios Finales - RBF)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (electronic final-beneficiaries registry), accessed through the RUES/Chamber of Commerce portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the DIAN RBF calendar; a no-change confirmation is normally aligned with the annual commercial registry renewal cycle, whereas any share transfer must be declared within the legal update period established by DIAN
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-compliance is a formal tax infringement; DIAN may impose fines up to 13,000 UVT per missing or inaccurate final-beneficiary declaration and may block registry renewals and good-standing certificates.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A Colombian S.A.S. is required to appoint a Revisor Fiscal (statutory auditor) when, as of 31 December of the preceding fiscal year, gross assets or gross income exceed 5,000 SMMLV (approximately COP 6.5 billion / USD 1.6 million in 2025); audit is also mandatory when the articles of association require it, when the company belongs to a regulated/supervised sector such as financial or public-interest services, or when shareholders holding at least 25% of subscribed capital make a qualified request. An executive-search S.A.S. below these thresholds may function with an internal accountant and a review/compilation report, without a full statutory audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Colombian statutory accounting framework under Law 1314 of 2009, Decreto 2420 of 2015 and Decreto 2483 of 2018; a typical S.A.S. in ISIC 7830 applies Grupo 2 IFRS for SMEs (NIIF para Pymes).

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The S.A.S. must keep the shareholder register continuously endorsed so that persons holding economic ownership at the 31 December balance-sheet date correspond with the registered shareholding. Share transfers are perfected against the company only upon entry of the transfer in the Register of Shareholders. At each year-end and before the annual commercial registry renewal, the legal representative must confirm the current final-beneficiary information; if no change occurred, a no-change confirmation is filed in the DIAN RBF. If a share transfer took place during the year, the updated beneficial-ownership list must be filed in the RBF before the next annual renewal. No notarization is required for S.A.S. share transfers, but registration with the Chamber of Commerce and endorsement in the corporate ledger are necessary to make the transfer opposable to third parties.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Shareholders (Libro de Registro de Accionistas)
Register of Directors and Managers (Libro de Registro de Junta Directiva o Administradores, if constituted)
Shareholders' Minute Book (Libro de Actas de Asamblea General)
Accounting Books, including the Journal and General Ledger (Libros de Contabilidad)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 250 - 500 per year for registered-office and commercial registry support in Bogotá or Medellín; Chamber of Commerce registrations, certificates and RUES filings are invoiced separately at official tariff rates
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,200 - 3,000 for a full statutory IFRS audit when the Revisor Fiscal threshold is crossed; USD 400 - 900 for an annual review or compilation report for a small S.A.S. below the audit threshold

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general tax holiday or preferential flat-tax regime applies to a Colombian S.A.S. engaged in executive search/headhunting. Certain narrowly constructed deductions may marginally reduce effective taxation, e.g. 130%/higher payroll deductions for employees with disabilities or for approved investment in science, technology, innovation, and environmental improvement. Export VAT void for B2B placement services does not reduce income tax. A presumptive income (renta presuntiva) charge continues to apply, so a dormant S.A.S. may owe tax on a statutory deemed return even without actual operating profit.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 230 (Declaración de Renta y Complementarios para Personas Jurídicas y Asimiladas) filed electronically through DIAN MUISCE (Modelo Único de Ingresos, Servicio y Control Electrónico) using an electronic signature.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filing deadline is fixed each year by DIAN resolution based on the last two digits of the taxpayer’s NIT. For a standard calendar-year S.A.S., the return generally falls due in the months of March through June of the following year. The taxpayer must observe the exact annual DIAN payment/filing calendar.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: NIT, legal name, fiscal year, filing status, signature, and mandatory settlement declaration.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A Colombian S.A.S. is a resident Colombian taxpayer; insert the Colombian NIT and registered address. Foreign shareholders' personal data should not populate this box unless they are also legal representatives.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross assets at the close of the tax period per the approved balance sheet.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Evidence the actual Colombian S.A.S. balance sheet; branch or PE filers include only Colombian PE assets. Executive-search firms must not exclude retainer work-in-progress and accounts receivable from the gross asset base.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: All gross revenues from executive-search retainers, success fees, outsourcing, or related services.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Billings to foreign clients are Colombian-source when the contracted executive-search personnel and management activity are located in Colombia. The foreign destination of the invoice does not make the income non-taxable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 4 – Non-Taxable Income / Ingresos No Constitutivos de Renta
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Recoveries of capital, dividends received previously taxed, or statutory non-taxable receipts.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Do not classify cross-border headhunting retainers as non-taxable. The category is not available for ordinary service revenue merely because the recipient is a foreign company or the payment arrives in foreign currency.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 5 – Returns, Discounts and Rebates / Devoluciones y Descuentos
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Contractual cancellations, discounts and rebates that reduce grossing billing.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only actual, contractually documented refunds made to client companies are deductible; unsubstantiated clawbacks created for income shifting will be reversed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 6 – Ordinary Net Liquid Income / Renta Líquida Ordinaria
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross taxable income minus deductible costs and expenses; the ordinary net liquid income before exempt items and loss carryforwards.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Claim employee placement costs, recruiter salaries, candidate database expenses, marketing, overhead and legitimate subcontractor fees. Do not deduct group management fees lacking goods/services evidence and arm's-length testing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statutory exemptions, generally marginal for ordinary headhunting/BPO income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Do not claim a blanket exemption for 'exported services'. Colombian income tax law does not grant a general exclusion for digital recruitment services sold to U.S., EU, or LatAm clients.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 8 – Taxable Net Income / Renta Líquida Gravable
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: The base taxed at the 35% corporate rate after deducting exempt income, statutory loss carryforwards, and all applicable adjustments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Carryforward and offset computations are made at entity level only. A non-resident shareholder cannot take a Colombian loss or income item onto its home-country return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 9 – Corporate Income Tax / Impuesto a Cargo
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 35% closing corporate income tax on taxable net income reduced by credits for withholdings and prepayments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign shareholders should not net their dividend withholding on this line; the corporate tax and the distribution-stage WHT are independent stages.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 10 – Advanced Payments and Withholdings / Anticipos y Retenciones
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax prepayments, invoice withholdings and credits recoverable against the final corporate income tax.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter Colombian-source withholdings formally reported by clients. Payments abroad via Wise or wire without Colombian tax withholding do not create credits without an enforced tax treaty or DIAN protocol.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Empty or late filing triggers the DIAN extemporaneous-return penalty: 5% of the assessed income tax for each month or fraction of month of delay, capped at 100% of the tax due. When the return shows no tax due, a monthly surcharge equal to 1% of gross income applies. The penalty is increased by half when the late declaration is made after DIAN has initiated a collection or official-request process. Default interest is additionally charged from the original due date to the date of payment.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: Statutory rate is 5% on dividend distributions paid out of profits already subjected to corporate income tax; distributions sourced from nontaxed profits are subject to 35% withholding tax at the moment of distribution. A non-resident shareholder under a Colombian DTA may claim a reduced rate (commonly 5% to 10% for substantial holders) on the taxable dividend portion.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke DTA relief on dividends, royalties or interest, the foreign beneficial owner must (i) be a resident for tax purposes of the treaty jurisdiction, (ii) hold a current official Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) issued by that jurisdiction’s tax administration, (iii) substantiate beneficial ownership — not agent, nominee, or conduit status — and (iv) transmit the TRC and beneficial ownership declaration to the Colombian withholding agent before the payment is settled. The withholding agent retains the documents as part of the evidence file and, where required, reports the reduced-rate application in DIAN electronic informational forms. DIAN may challenge the exemption if the foreign recipient lacks economic substance and merely back-to-backs Colombian earnings.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory Colombian withholding is 20% for royalties and technical know-how, and 15% for debt interest paid to foreign lenders. DTA-reduced rates generally range from 5% to 15% for interest and 5% to 10% for royalties; zero withholding may apply to specific export-financing interest under a treaty. Applicability requires both a valid TRC and genuine economic substance in the foreign recipient, especially for intercompany financing and IP licensing structures.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Colombia uses UVTs (Unidad de Valor Tributario) rather than a fixed peso flat line. For tax year 2024, mandatory Local File documentation is triggered when the taxpayer's gross income exceeds 150,000 UVT (approximately COP 7,179,750,000 using the 2024 UVT of COP 47,865) or when net worth exceeds 45,000 UVT (approximately COP 2,153,925,000). Multinational groups with consolidated revenues above the Colombian CbC threshold are also required to maintain a Master File and file Country-by-Country data; all threshold amounts are adjusted annually by DIAN resolution.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Colombia does not enact a UAE-style standalone Economic Substance Regulation, but the doctrine is enforced through general anti-abuse rules, beneficial-ownership clauses in DTAs, PE attribution principles, and DIAN's authority to disregard artificial step-up schemes. An executive-search S.A.S. must maintain real personnel, an operational office, candidate and contract files, payroll registrations, and decision-making management in Colombia; a shell company with nominal ownership and no local activity will have deductions disallowed, the substance of the foreign parent ignored, and treaty access denied.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate understatement of retainer and success-fee income; issuance of invoices to offshore group companies at zero or nominal value while the executive-search work is performed in Colombia; recording fictitious candidate and payroll costs; omission of Colombian banking deposits.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DIAN raises a tax adjustment equal to the omitted tax together with default interest and imposes the 'sanción por inexactitud' of 100% of the understatement, increased to 200% when transactions involve related offshore parties or sham arrangements. Criminal tax fraud can produce imprisonment of 5 to 9 years, fines, seizure of corporate and personal assets, and cancellation of the S.A.S. RUT.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and legal representatives who knowingly sign false returns or cause back-to-back invoicing may be personally liable for the corporate underpayment, subject to a travel ban when leaving Colombia, entered into the DIAN administrative enforcement register, and exposed to personal indemnity actions. The Colombian criminal court may issue pre-trial preventive detention and an order prohibiting departure from the national territory.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Paying large, undocumented management or marketing fees to a foreign affiliate; charging headquarters a sub-arm's-length margin for candidate placement; concluding a loan from a related entity without interest or with interest deviating from Colombian market rates; failing to submit a Transfer Pricing Return and Local File.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DIAN may disregard the controlled transaction and recharacterize the full Colombian revenue at arm's length, resulting in an increased taxable income, 35% tax, default interest, and a transfer pricing documentation sanction computed on the value of the transactions (up to 25% of the value of the omitted operations). A 100% understatement penalty for TP misstatement is also imposed.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who approve non-arm's-length arrangements with shareholder affiliates are jointly responsible for the company's tax deficit to the extent of fraud or gross negligence. They may be debarred from serving in the S.A.S., required to reimburse corporate damages, and criminally liable if they knowingly forged intercompany service agreements.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining a Colombian S.A.S. with no physical office, no employees under Colombian labor contracts, no local bank account, no local management, and a nominee shareholder/professional service provider; using this shell to pass candidate placements to a parent abroad and claim DTA low withholding rates.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DIAN and the competent registry may declare the entity fiscally nonexistent for tax purposes, disallow all costs, tax the gross billings, apply the 100% inexactitude penalty, and levy additional sanctions for carrying on economic activity without an effective RUT and properly registered books. The supervising chamber of commerce may initiate administrative cancellation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Under S.A.S. Law 1258/2008, misuse of the legal entity to conceal individual operations and evade or defraud creditors or the tax authority pierces the corporate veil. Directors, shareholders and beneficial owners become personally and solidarily liable for the S.A.S.'s tax debts, plus civil damages and criminal sanctions for fraud.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML Violations and Fraudulent Payment Rails
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Receiving retainer funds into informal or third-party accounts; accepting payments from unknown beneficial owners through Wise or crypto channels; failing to apply UAFE suspicious-transaction reporting because the client resides in a high-risk jurisdiction; deliberately converting cross-border placement fees into nonexistent consulting contracts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: UAFE penalties for non-reporting can reach significant economic fines; money-laundering under Colombian Criminal Code Articles 323 and 325 is punished with 10 to 15 years’ imprisonment, fines equivalent to hundreds of statutory minimum salaries, asset forfeiture, and closure of the S.A.S.'s bank account by the Colombian Financial Superintendence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, compliance officers and nominal shareholders who monitor but do not report suspicious flows face personal criminal liability as co-authors or 'determinadores' of money laundering. Personal travel bans, confiscation of personal property, and imprisonment apply irrespective of the corporate form, and civil restitution may be claimed by harmed partners, clients and the State.
